name: Trengo Circus Festival
description: The city becomes a stage as the Trengo Festival fills Porto's squares and theaters with breathtaking contemporary circus arts. Check the schedule for daily performances.
longDescription:
The Trengo Circus Festival is an annual event that transforms Porto into a hub for contemporary circus arts. For one week, the festival presents a program of performances across various locations in the city, including public squares and established theaters. It aims to showcase a range of modern circus disciplines and artistic expressions.

Visitors can expect a diverse program of acts, encompassing acrobatics, juggling, clowning, and aerial performances. The festival's decentralized format means performances take place in different settings, from open-air public spaces to indoor venues. The atmosphere is generally accessible, with events suitable for a broad audience.

The festival runs from June 25 to July 1, 2026. Specific performance times and locations are detailed in the daily schedule, which is available closer to the event dates. Ticket prices vary depending on the performance and venue. Information regarding specific venue accessibility and public transport options will be provided with the full program.
